hypothesis: PLSR never certifies a decrease form that is only semidefinite or indefinite: skew-symmetric plants with P = I give an exactly zero form and must be NUMERICAL_INCONCLUSIVE; defective (Jordan) plants are certified with P = I exactly when lambda > 1/2; a semidefinite Q is refused by the solver.
input_data: 5 skew-symmetric matrices n = 2..6 (PCG64 seed 104) with P = I and with SPD P

marginal A = 0, diag(0, -1), [[0, 1], [0, 0]]; Jordan blocks with P = I (l in 0.25..2) and with the CIW Lyapunov P (l in 1e-3..1); A = [[-1, 1], [0, -2]] with Q = diag(1, 0); discrete rotations and diag(1, -1)
Candidates P = R diag(1, 1e-17) R^T (seed 1041, up to 40000 draws): 8 that NumPy's eigvalsh calls positive definite although they are exactly indefinite, and 8 exactly positive definite controls
mathematical_model: Skew A: A^T + A = 0 exactly; with any P, trace(A^T P + P A) = 0 so the form is never negative definite. Jordan A = [[-l, 1], [0, -l]], P = I: M = [[-2l, 1], [1, -2l]] is negative definite iff l > 1/2 and singular at l = 1/2. Orthogonal discrete A: A^T A - I = 0 up to rounding.
numerical_result: 28 edge cases: 0 certifying verdicts on non-definite forms, 0 codes outside the class expectation. Skew with P = I: {'NUMERICAL_INCONCLUSIVE': 5}. Jordan with P = I: {'Jordan lambda=0.25, P=I': 'DECREASE_NOT_DEFINITE', 'Jordan lambda=0.49, P=I': 'DECREASE_NOT_DEFINITE', 'Jordan lambda=0.5, P=I': 'NUMERICAL_INCONCLUSIVE', 'Jordan lambda=0.51, P=I': 'CERTIFIED_WITH_MARGIN', 'Jordan lambda=1.0, P=I': 'CERTIFIED_WITH_MARGIN', 'Jordan lambda=2.0, P=I': 'CERTIFIED_WITH_MARGIN'}. Solver and constructor: {'solve:0.001': 'P returned', 'solve:0.01': 'P returned', 'solve:0.1': 'P returned', 'solve:1.0': 'P returned', 'solve:psdQ': 'raises ValueError', 'quadratic:psd': 'raises ValueError'}. Candidates (8207 draws searched): 16/16 accepted by quadratic(), 8 of them exactly indefinite; verdicts on accepted candidates: 0 certifying of 32 (codes and the accepted indefinite P are retained in the artifact). Conclusion: no semidefinite, skew or indefinite edge case was certified; the constructor's floating-point eigenvalue-sign test is not an exact definiteness test, and no verdict certified with an exactly indefinite P it admitted.
